Which build does this policy cover?

This notice covers the current Pixel Heist development build. Before real advertising or payment providers are enabled, the policy will be updated to match the released build’s data practices.

Information kept on your device

Game progress, collection, in-game balances, and settings are stored in local save files. The current build does not create an Oyri Games account or upload these saves to our servers.

Advertising, purchases, and analytics

The reviewed development build simulates ads and purchases with test providers; these tests do not charge real money or connect to an ad network. An active third-party analytics provider has not been verified for this build.

Deleting your saves

Remove the app and its local data from your device to delete saves. Exported images and separately retained backups are not automatically deleted. Make sure you are ready to lose your progress before deleting it.

Requests and contact
